notes.title: 《蛮之纪》DEMO现已推出
notes.content:
Dear players,

We've just released the first open free demo of Savage Age for the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

The demo consists of the first 7 levels to show how the core gameplay works, but it should give you a taste of what the full game is like. And don't forget to wishlist it if you like the demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080140/

Savage Age is a labor of love that combines survival, combat, base building, puzzle solving, and even tower defense into a single game. The game revolves around a hero's quest in an eon of strife to save the holy totem of his tribe, thus beginning a journey of romance and adventures. As a solo studio, I have been working on this game for a few years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685967/f54e011041eae8fca23607b306f6d23139c43d25.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy it and feel free to let us know what you think of it, welcome to join our discord: 
[url=https://discord.gg/NubrC3RzeV]https://discord.gg/NubrC3RzeV[/url]

And please don't forget to check the demo builds from our other games:
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indienova/list/98354
